data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate experienced a significant gross reserve release of GBP 250.3 million in 2017, primarily driven by favorable claims development on prior underwriting years. The 2016 Year of Account performed creditably despite being affected by Hurricane Matthew and fires in Alberta, while the 2015 Year of Account performed well due to a benign period of losses. This indicates that initial reserving was cautious, and subsequent claims experience proved more favorable than anticipated, leading to releases as the ultimate cost of claims became more certain.
raw_causal_phrases: The 2016 Year of Account has performed creditably given that it was affected by Hurricane Matthew and fires in Alberta, the year is forecast to be better than plan
The 2015 Year of Account has performed well and has returned a return on stamp of 16.1% thanks to a benign period of losses and a stronger rating environment than that experienced in 2017.
As claims develop, and the ultimate cost of claims becomes more certain, the relative level of margin maintained should decrease.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is calculated from the gross claims development triangle on page 35, by comparing the current estimate of cumulative claims incurred for each underwriting year (2011-2015) to its estimate from the previous diagonal (one year prior). The 'Liability for gross outstanding claims (2010 and before)' of GBP 1.5m was added to this sum.
